meta.title: Pure chat
meta.description: Adds a selectable agent preset that sends your conversation straight to the model and lets it search the web with web_search and web_fetch. It carries no system prompt and mounts no file, shell, terminal, skill, subagent, team, or goal tools. Create a new session, choose “纯对话 / Pure chat” in the preset control, then send your first message. The model still receives the one working-directory runtime note DSH requires, the two web tools' brief descriptions stand in for the suppressed tool guidance, and long conversations are not compacted.
